definition: Assess whether the student completed all tasks due in the reporting period. Apply a negative score only when at least one such task is explicitly unfinished. Exclude future work and tasks explicitly deferred by agreement before they became due.
positive_criteria: Explicitly reports that all tasks due in the period were completed
Accounts for completion of every task in the stated set of due tasks
negative_criteria: Identifies at least one task due in the period that remains incomplete
Reports a due deliverable as blocked, partially complete, or abandoned without an agreed deferral
